description.value: The Agassiz Library is a branch of the Fraser Valley Regional Library, serving the small community of Agassiz at the eastern end of the Fraser Valley. It is a fully accessible, ground-level building with automatic doors, making it an easy and welcoming indoor rest stop for touring cyclists passing through the area. The library is part of a regional system spanning numerous communities across the Fraser Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website's Features list for this branch explicitly confirms 'Outdoor Bike Racks,' 'WiFi,' 'Public Computers,' 'Accessible Restrooms,' and 'Copying/Printing/Scanning,' among others. The address (7140 Cheam Avenue, Agassiz BC V0M 1A3) and phone (604-796-9510) on the website match OSM values. No mention of water refill, showers, food, device charging, e-bike charging, or bike pump on the website, so those remain null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A public library is a practical and welcoming stop for touring cyclists, offering free restrooms, WiFi, outdoor bike racks, and a comfortable indoor space to rest in the small community of Agassiz.

Bike parking.detail: Outdoor Bike Racks listed as a branch feature on the website

blurb: Accessible public library in Agassiz at the Fraser Valley's east end.
